Partnerships & go-to-market

• Co-develop our partnerships and go-to-market approach together with our Partnerships Lead.

Account management

• Proactively manage key client accounts and nurture relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.

offers.title: 🦾 AI Deployment Strategist
offers.description:
🤝 The job

A client has decided agentic AI is the way forward. Budget approved, sponsor enthusiastic, (potential) use cases selected. Nothing runs yet. That's where you come in. You turn their ambition into a solution that works on their data, in their system, with their people, under their constraints.

The AI Deployment Strategist role is a combination of building and spending time with the people who’ll use what you build, watching how they work today and where they lose their time. That combination is what makes this role different from other engineering positions that own the deep technical work, and the platforms it runs on. You sit closer to the business: you advise on what gets built, you build the working version, and you care whether anyone ends up using it.

🧠 What you'll be doing

Decide what to build

  • Sit with the people doing the work and map how it really happens, not how the documentation says it does

  • Find the real bottleneck, and design the process you'd build today with agents in it from the start

  • Pressure-test the use cases on the table: what's feasible, what the data allows, what it takes to build

  • Challenge the brief: push back when the approved use case isn’t the one worth building, when it needs a process fix first, or when an agent is the wrong tool

  • Raise the questions early that have a big impact later: data, privacy, compliance, ownership of the decision, etc.

Build it

  • Build the solutions (RAG-based assistants, agentic workflows, automation, etc.) that connect to the client's data and systems

  • Write code that runs in production, working with the client's architects and security people to get it live in their environment

  • Decide where the agent acts alone and where a person signs off, and shape that handoff so people trust it

  • Set up the evaluation and monitoring the client needs to trust it over time

Make it stick

  • Train the people who'll use what you built and the engineers who'll maintain it

  • Capture feedback from stakeholders on outcomes and iterate to keep improving the value

  • Write the documentation the client’s team needs to keep it running and extend on what you built

offers.title: 🔮 AI Strategy Consultant
offers.description:
More and more organizations are eager to adopt AI. However, many lack a clear strategy, leading to inefficiencies, missed opportunities and increased risks. While technical challenges like model selection, data readiness and scalability are critical, organizations also need guidance on strategic topics such as governance, AI literacy, operational impact and business alignment.

At Dataroots, we don’t just build data solutions. We make sure our customers are empowered to use them to their fullest potential.

We’re a scale-up with a big vision, which means you’ll thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where your ideas matter. Here, you’ll have the chance to help shape new offerings, identify growth opportunities, and make a real impact—not just in the tech you create, but in the way companies think about their data. If you’re passionate about modern data management, love the idea of working on projects that challenge the status quo, and want to be part of a team building a better future with data, Dataroots is the place for you.

Ready to make an impact? Let’s grow together!

🎉 What you can expect at Dataroots

Since its inception in 2016, Dataroots has been dedicated to enhancing its customers' operations through superior data-driven methodologies. We prioritize the well-being and development of our team, fostering an environment of diversity and continuous learning. By joining us, you'll not only contribute to our growth but also enjoy a nurturing and innovative work environment. Learn more about our philosophy at [https://dataroots.io/our-dna].

🤖 The Job 
As an AI Strategy consultant, you will combine client and internal responsibilities:

Client-facing:

You will…

  • Drive workshops and strategic discussions to understand how AI can support the business ambitions.

  • Educate management and teams on AI’s transformative potential, technical and organizational considerations and risks.

  • Lead the identification and development of high-impact AI opportunities, translating cutting-edge advancements into actionable business use cases that drive real value.

  • Advise on the latest LLM developments, emerging technologies and key industry players, ensuring strategic decision-making is informed by the latest AI innovations.

  • Communicate and advise on AI’s business value through compelling narratives, strategic roadmaps and advisory support for leadership and clients.

  • Oversee and ensure successful execution of AI projects, managing risk, timelines and stakeholder expectations to maximize impact.

  • Align AI initiatives with clients' broader business strategies, ensuring AI-driven solutions integrate seamlessly into their operations, innovation roadmaps, and long-term objectives.

  • Drive AI adoption, upskilling efforts and culture shifts, ensuring teams understand and embrace AI responsibly.

Internal:

You will…

  • Support business development efforts, contributing to proposals, pre-sales engagements and strategic AI consulting to expand market opportunities.

  • Take ownership of internal knowledge sharing and training initiatives, ensuring our teams stay at the forefront of AI advancements and best practices.

offers.title: 📊 Data Management Engineer
offers.description:
Do you enjoy turning complex data challenges into practical, trusted solutions?
As a Data Management Engineer at Dataroots, you help organisations build data foundations they can truly rely on - and actually use.

You work hands-on with clients to design, implement, and embed modern data management practices. From data quality frameworks and catalogs to governance processes that stick, you make sure data doesn’t just exist - it creates value.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, people, and process, in a scale-up environment where your ideas and initiative matter.

🚀 What you’ll do

Build data foundations that work

  • Implement data quality frameworks, data catalogs, and master data solutions

  • Translate business needs into practical, scalable data management setups

  • Ensure solutions are adopted, embedded, and used in daily operations

Collaborate closely with people

  • Work with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Support governance processes and train teams on tools and best practices

  • Help organisations grow their data maturity in a sustainable way

Grow with us

  • Contribute to new offerings, ideas, and ways of working

  • Take ownership and help shape how we approach data management

🎉 Why this role?

  • Real impact: you empower teams to trust and use their data

  • Variety: work across different clients, sectors, and challenges

  • Growth: learn, experiment, and shape your path in a fast-growing scale-up

  • Support: strong focus on collaboration, learning, and wellbeing
